description: Run Fudge’s free product schema and catalogue audit: product markup, categories, product details and whether AI buyer searches find the right products, with a score and prioritized fixes. Waits up to 45 seconds. Reuses a running or fresh result unless `fresh` is true; an active run is always shared.

domain.description: The Shopify storefront to check, e.g. example.com. Required until a store is connected; afterwards, omit it to use a connected store.

fresh.description: Start a new run even when a result from the last 24 hours exists.

store.description: The connected store to use. Omit when only one is connected.

name: run_catalog_data_audit
title: Run catalog data audit
